purpose: Notify customers that a hypothetical bicycle repair shop's Saturday pickup hours changed
audience: Customers who already left bicycles for repair
reader_knowledge: They know the workshop but not the new pickup window
core_point: Saturday pickups will be 10 a.m. to 1 p.m. for this fictional scenario
known_facts: Fictional scenario: Saturday pickup hours are 10 a.m. to 1 p.m. from December 5.
Customers may pick up on Monday if Saturday does not work.
unknowns: No reason for the change was provided.

purpose: Explain an avoidable scheduling error and the correction
known_facts: Fictional scenario: the Thursday shift was assigned to the wrong person.
The corrected rota will be shared by 4 p.m.

purpose: Explain why a fictional museum is considering written transcripts beside audio guides
reader_knowledge: They know how to listen to guides, but not about the prototype
known_facts: The current exhibit guide offers recorded audio only.
The proposed version adds a Transcript button with the same scripted description.
No visitor testing has occurred.
unknowns: Actual visitor preference and comprehension effects are unknown.

purpose: Explain a simple password reset process for a hypothetical community website
known_facts: Fictional flow: choose Forgot password, enter account email, follow the reset link.
The link expires after 30 minutes.
unknowns: Whether the email will arrive within a particular time is unknown.

purpose: Explain how to prepare for a first meeting with a financial adviser without offering investment recommendations
audience: Adults new to personal financial planning
reader_knowledge: They know their approximate income and expenses
known_facts: A useful preparation can include listing income, expenses, debts, savings goals and questions.
unknowns: The reader's legal and tax jurisdiction is unspecified.

purpose: Explain a schedule for a fictional neighborhood clean-up
known_facts: Fictional event: 9 a.m. Saturday at the community center.
Gloves and rubbish bags are provided.
Volunteers should bring drinking water.

purpose: Evaluate whether public institutions should move some services online
reader_knowledge: Some have used online public services and some have not
known_facts: Digital services can reduce some travel needs.
Not everyone has stable internet or the same digital skills.
unknowns: No local cost or adoption data is supplied.

purpose: Recommend a small trial of clearer signage for a fictional public garden
reader_knowledge: They know visitors sometimes ask for directions
known_facts: The existing garden has one entrance map.
The proposed trial adds two directional signs to the demonstration area.
No visitor measurements exist yet.

purpose: Explore how people can recognize a slow change that is easy to miss day to day
reader_knowledge: They have experienced gradual change in ordinary life
known_facts: Use hypothetical examples only; no personal history is provided.

purpose: Examine how people learn a new skill through examples, practice, feedback and revision
reader_knowledge: They are familiar with everyday learning experiences
known_facts: Use illustrative hypothetical learning situations.
Do not invent research statistics or quotations.
unknowns: No specific empirical papers are supplied in the task packet.

purpose: Explain what an HTTP 404 response means using a website example
reader_knowledge: They know what a webpage is but not HTTP status codes
known_facts: HTTP 404 indicates the requested resource was not found on the server.
It does not by itself prove the entire site is offline.

purpose: Help a community tool-lending shed choose how to label shared tools
reader_knowledge: They have a collection of shared hand tools
known_facts: Options include labels by tool type, borrowing frequency, or a hybrid.
Each system needs clear signs.
unknowns: The tool inventory and usage frequency are unknown.
